namibia.title: Flag of the Republic of Namibia

colors.note: Represents the sky, the Atlantic Ocean, and Namibia's precious water resources.
Symbolises the Namibian people and their determination to build a future of equal opportunity.
The gold sun represents life and energy.

desc:
- A diagonal red band edged with white divides the flag, with blue in the upper hoist and green in the lower fly
- A 12-ray golden sun sits in the blue upper hoist triangle
- Adopted on 21 March 1990 at independence from South African administration
trivia:
- The 12-ray golden sun echoes the motif on the flag of the South West Africa People's Organisation (SWAPO)
- The diagonal colour scheme was chosen from over 800 design proposals submitted during independence
- Namibia was the last African country under European-originated rule to achieve independence
- The flag design was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on 2 February 1990
